product_overview: CareerBoost is an AI-powered career development assistant designed specifically for B.Tech AI & Data Science students. It provides a consolidated platform for discovering certifications, internships, hackathons, project ideas, AI tools, and the latest tech news to accelerate student careers in AI and Data Science.
core_goals: Provide a comprehensive and easy-to-use platform for students to find relevant career-building resources such as certifications, internships, and hackathons.
Enable user authentication and personalized experiences including saving items and applying for internships.
Keep students informed with up-to-date technology news and AI tool recommendations tailored to their skill level.
Support career growth by offering curated project ideas and tools for practical learning and portfolio development.
Ensure secure, performant, and scalable backend supporting all API interactions and data management.
key_features: User authentication system including registration, login, token verification, and OTP verification.
Certificate discovery and management with search and save functionality.
Internship listings with search, filter, application submission, and saved items feature.
Hackathon calendar with listings of upcoming events and ability to save hackathons.
Tech news feed categorized by topics with search capability.
AI tool recommendations categorized by user skill level and type.
Project ideas including generation of custom project suggestions and management.
User profile and skills management with ability to track saved items and applications.
Modern UI features including dark/light mode, glassmorphism design, smooth animations, and full responsiveness.
user_flow_summary: Users register and authenticate using email and password with optional OTP verification for enhanced security.
After login, users can browse and search for certificates, internships, hackathons, news articles, AI tools, and projects from the main dashboard or navigation menus.
Users can save items of interest (certificates, internships, hackathons) to their personal profile for quick access later.
Internship applications can be submitted through the platform after users select an internship and apply.
Users can view and update their profile information and manage skills.
Users receive AI tool recommendations based on their skill levels and interests.
Project ideas can be viewed or generated dynamically to assist users in portfolio building.
Users stay informed by browsing categorized news feeds or searching for relevant news articles.
validation_criteria: All authentication endpoints support secure registration, login, token validation, and OTP verification with proper error handling.
Certificate, internship, hackathon, news, tools, and project APIs respond correctly to requests including searches, retrievals, saving, and application posting.
Frontend UI must provide seamless dark/light mode toggling with consistent glassmorphism and responsive design.
User profile updates and skill management are reflected accurately in the backend database.
Saved items for users are persistently stored and retrievable across sessions.
Internship application submissions are recorded and associated with the correct user profiles.
API response times meet performance benchmarks ensuring fast data loading.
Deployment process documented and tested to ensure smooth launch on platforms like Railway (backend) and Vercel (frontend).
